DISCOGS_CONSUMER_KEY.description: Your Discogs app **Consumer Key**. Register an app at [discogs.com/settings/developers](https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers) — name it anything, callback URL doesn't need to match yet (you'll update it after deploy).

DISCOGS_CONSUMER_SECRET.description: Your Discogs app **Consumer Secret** (shown alongside the Consumer Key on the same page).

JWT_SECRET.description: A random string used to sign session tokens. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Don't reuse across instances.

ALLOWED_DISCOGS_USER_ID.description: **Optional.** Numeric Discogs user ID(s) permitted to authenticate — comma-separated for multiple users (e.g. `123456,789012`). Find your ID at `https://api.discogs.com/users/<your-username>`. Leave blank for an open instance.
